title: Doll, Dog and Death
description: A porcelain-like broken doll with black stitched eyes and floral patterns lies on the floor, its head cradled by a pale woman with dark hair in buns who sits on a green couch. A large brown and black dog rests its head on the doll while a hooded Grim Reaper figure stands behind them in a dark room filled with glowing orbs, pentagrams, and occult symbols.
prompt: A surreal dark scene showing a cracked porcelain doll with black stitched eyes and star patterns lying on the floor, its head gently held by a pale woman with hair in buns sitting on a green vintage couch. A large brown and black dog rests its head on the doll's chest. Behind them looms a hooded Grim Reaper figure. The dark room contains floating glowing orbs, pentagrams, occult symbols and spiderwebs on the walls, moody cinematic lighting, detailed linework.
